source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of alcohols and their classes (PDF 89-90).

blocks.text: Hydroxyl group (-OH) tamam alcohols ka functional group hai, jin ka aam formula ROH hai, jahan R alkyl group hai. Is khandan mein cholesterol aur carbohydrates jaise maanoos maadde bhi shamil hain. Methanol (CH3OH) aur ethanol (CH3CH2OH) monohydric alcohols ki homologous series ke pehle do arkaan hain.

items: -OH groups ki tadaad se: monohydric alcohols mein aik (ethanol, propan-1-ol); polyhydric alcohols mein aik se zyada, maslan ethane-1,2-diol (glycol, do) aur propane-1,2,3-triol (glycerol, teen).
-OH wale carbon se: primary (1) alcohol, RCH2OH, mein yeh aik doosre carbon se jura (methanol mein kisi se nahi); secondary (2) alcohol, R2CHOH, mein do se; tertiary (3) alcohol, R3COH, mein teen se.

blocks.alt: Oopar: ethanol aur propan-1-ol (monohydric), ethane-1,2-diol ya glycol (dihydric) aur propane-1,2,3-triol ya glycerol (trihydric). Neeche: OH wala carbon H, H aur R ke saath (primary, RCH2OH, maslan ethanol), R, R aur H ke saath (secondary, R2CHOH, maslan propan-2-ol), aur teen R groups ke saath (tertiary, R3COH, maslan 2-methylpropan-2-ol).
blocks.caption: Alcohols ki taqseem (kitab ki misalon ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Alcohols is par taqseem hote hain ke molecule mein kitne hydroxyl groups hain aur har OH ke liye us ke carbon se kitne carbon atoms jure hain. Qism tay karti hai ke alcohol kaise oxidise hoga.

blocks.prompt: Quick Check 22.1 mein bane chhe alcohols ko primary, secondary ya tertiary batayein.
blocks.explanation: Khaakon se parh kar: (a) 3-methylbutan-1-ol, primary; (b) 2-methylbutan-2-ol, tertiary; (c) butan-2-ol, secondary; (d) seedhi zanjeer wala alkan-1-ol, primary; (e) 3-methylbutan-2-ol, secondary; (f) cyclopentanol, secondary.

items: Primary RCH2OH, secondary R2CHOH, tertiary R3COH.
